title: Bacharelado em Matemática da Tecnologia e Inovação (turma 2027)
institution: IMPA Tech (Instituto de Matemática Pura e Aplicada)
about: IMPA Tech has published the selection call for its 2027 undergraduate class in Mathematics of Technology and Innovation: 150 places in Rio de Janeiro and Teresina. Registration runs from 3 November (9h) to 23 December 2026 (12h).
requirements: Selection based on medals in five science olympiads or the ENEM mathematics score (2024, 2025 or 2026 scores accepted)
Two phases, including group activities and individual online interviews
150 places split between Rio de Janeiro and Teresina; the 50 IMPA Tech Nordeste places depend on approvals
Registration on the IMPA Tech website

upskill.name: the Data Analytics Academy page
why: No course scored a genuine match: shortlist hits were incidental words ("technology", "approval", "group") in AI governance/leadership objectives, unrelated to an undergraduate mathematics admission.

Closest catalog content: field "Mathematics, technology and innovation" → A005.01 Statistical & Mathematical Foundations I, "Build a practical foundation in descriptive statistics…", which does not cover the stated selection criteria (olympiad medals / ENEM mathematics score), so the Data Analytics Academy page is used instead of a specific course.
